title: Sales Order Material Reconciliation
purpose: Prove locator recovery, material reference coverage, safe review behavior and replay after an approved reference-data change.

sequence.point: Table and headers drift safely; new material EXT-Q9 is unresolved.
Reviewer approves a scoped mapping to MAT-471103.
Reference data receives a new released version.
Same source replays with pinned updated reference data.

assertions: Table movement alone does not require a procedure revision.
Approved header aliases may recover structural drift.
Unknown material values never receive guessed business mappings.
Reference changes are versioned and linked to a decision.
Replay records exact procedure and reference versions.
modelFindings: Field aliases are explicit, but locator contracts do not yet reference a reusable semantic alias set directly.
A reference-data decision may require a small procedure revision when the procedure pins exact reference versions.
Safe failure needs expected run evidence, not only a test assertion.
